any: * Kris is looking at you. It's hard to tell what they're thinking.
* Kris adjusts their sweater. Somehow this communicates a lot.
* Kris doesn't flinch. They've been through worse.
* Kris gives you a Look. It is a very specific Look.
* Kris's eye twitches. The dark one. Just saying.
* Kris is awake. Whether they slept is between them and the ceiling.
* Kris pulls their sword out of nowhere and puts it back. For practice.
* Kris nods at {app}. They use it often.
* Kris has no opinion on {app}. Or many opinions. Both, somehow.
* Kris watches the code scroll by. They're learning. Slowly. Menacingly.
* Kris would like a turn. Kris will not ask for a turn.
* Kris waves. Tiny wave. You saw it. Barely.
* Kris catches snow on their palm and watches it melt. Unblinking.
